This page summarises the matches of the '''third qualifying and play-off rounds''' of '''2012–13 UEFA Europa League qualifying'''.

Times are [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]), as listed by UEFA (local times, if different, are in parentheses).
